summary: Implemented and tested a bounded candidate enhancer for Live mobile expanded worker detail. The current static feed already publishes job-level pin_generation, owner, collision_count and authority_mode, so no feed-schema expansion or browser-side GitHub API access is required. The candidate maps a worker's job_id to those existing fields and renders only on card expansion, e.g. 'PIN G000002 · dueño worker-b · 1 colisión · recuperación'. Four Node tests pass. The remaining step is a Served mutation (installing the module into gh-pages/live and adding its module script tag) plus a real narrow-viewport browser canary; this worker did not cross that authority boundary.
